question: Ramana spends 75% of his income. His income is increased by 25% and he increases his expenditure by 10%. By what percentage are his savings increased?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial Income (I₁) = ₹100

Initial Expenditure (E₁) = 75% of I₁ = ₹75

Initial Savings (S₁) = I₁ - E₁ = ₹100 - ₹75 = ₹25

New Income (I₂) = I₁ + 25% of I₁ = ₹100 + ₹25 = ₹125
